evidence_policy: Covers are editorial; measured charts read the sanitized dual-engine summary. Public UI and Grafana evidence are verbatim copies of archived screenshots; no chart data or interface content is altered.

visual_review.short_chart: axis titles, scales, legend, markers and mobile readability checked
visual_review.workload_chart: labels, values and panel boundaries checked
visual_review.context_chart: SGLang and vLLM status labels checked against the archived context ladder
visual_review.topology: stage count, GPU count and storage labels checked
